record.name: Whitefish (Goodfish) Lake Guardians program
record.description: Funded invasive-species planning and Elders/youth stewardship work addressing burdock infestation. The December 2025 backgrounder describes the funded initiative, not a current completion milestone.
funding: Federal award: $50,000 for the 2025–2026 initiative; not total project cost.

record.name: Woodland caribou habitat Guardians monitoring
record.description: Funded community-led caribou habitat monitoring and land-based knowledge sharing between youth and Elders in Treaty 8 territory. Current implementation and completion are not established by the December 2025 backgrounder.
funding: Federal award: $50,000 for the 2025–2026 initiative; not total project cost.

record.name: Duncan’s First Nation Guardians initiative
record.description: Funded development of a Nation-led stewardship program to support the Lands Department, culturally significant areas and species monitoring. The December 2025 funding description does not establish current construction or completion status.
funding: Federal award: $50,000 for the 2025–2026 initiative; not total project cost.

record.name: Fort McKay Environmental Guardians expansion
record.description: Funded expansion of community-led wildlife, air and water monitoring in the Fort McKay/Moose Lake area. Staffing, monitoring equipment and a greenhouse food-security component are described in the December 2025 funding backgrounder.
funding: Federal award: $175,000 for the 2025–2026 initiative; not total project cost.

record.name: Chemawawin Guardians wildlife monitoring
record.description: Funded development of a wildlife monitoring plan guided by Elders, with Cree language and place-name learning and youth land stewardship. The December 2025 backgrounder describes the initiative; completion is not verified.
funding: Federal award: $50,000 for the 2025–2026 initiative; not total project cost.

record.name: Black River First Nation Land Guardian initiative
record.description: Funded support for a permanent Land Guardian, land-condition monitoring and collaboration with Elders and neighboring Guardian programs. The December 2025 funding backgrounder does not establish current implementation status.
funding: Federal award: $50,000 for the 2025–2026 initiative; not total project cost.

record.name: Marcel Colomb community Guardians stewardship
record.description: Funded community-led black sturgeon and shoreline monitoring, habitat assessment and land-based training guided by Elders and Knowledge-Holders. Status beyond the December 2025 project description is not independently verified.
funding: Federal award: $50,000 for the 2025–2026 initiative; not total project cost.

record.name: Baldock Lake Guardians fisheries assessment
record.description: Funded community-led fisheries baseline assessment at Baldock Lake, with Elders’ guidance and youth mentorship. The December 2025 description links this stewardship work to Indigenous/National Park planning, not approval or establishment of a park.
funding: Federal award: $50,000 for the 2025–2026 initiative; not total project cost.

record.name: Anishinaabe of Riding Mountain Indigenous Guardians
record.description: Funded launch of a Guardians program with Parks Canada, including youth training and stewardship in Riding Mountain National Park and Clear Lake Indian Reserve 61A. Current completion status is not established.
funding: Federal award: $50,000 for the 2025–2026 initiative; not total project cost.

record.name: Mosakahiken community Guardians program
record.description: Funded foundation-building for a community-led Moose Lake Guardians program, intergenerational knowledge sharing, a Culture Camp and future governance planning. The December 2025 description does not establish completion.
funding: Federal award: $50,000 for the 2025–2026 initiative; not total project cost.

record.name: Tthebatthie Dënésułıné Guardians program
record.description: Phase-one funding supports Dene Ch’anie revitalization, intergenerational land-based learning and skills for future Guardian activities. The December 2025 backgrounder places the funded work in the Northwest Territories.
funding: Federal award: $50,000 for the 2025–2026 initiative; not total project cost.

record.name: Athabasca Denesuliné caribou Guardians monitoring
record.description: A shared land-monitoring initiative for barren-ground caribou in Nuhenënë, guided by the Etthën Relationship Plan, Elders and Dene traditions. The December 2025 backgrounder names all three Nations; the $50,000 award is shared and not allocated per Nation.
record.relationshipType: Named participating First Nation; shared corporation award
funding: Shared federal award: $50,000; no per-Nation allocation reported.

record.name: Musko Api Nipi (Healthy Water) stewardship
record.description: September 2026 funding supports a technical advisory committee and an Aquanty water decision-support model for Hollow Water First Nation and the Lake Winnipeg Basin. Big Black Mukwa Management Services Inc. is the named recipient; Nation ownership of the company is not inferred.
record.relationshipType: Named beneficiary; award recipient is Big Black Mukwa Management Services Inc.
funding: Federal award: $100,000 over one year; not total project cost.

record.name: Mino Nibi community water-quality program
record.description: A September 2026 funded community-directed water-quality program involving youth monitoring, Elders’ guidance and collaboration with the University of Manitoba. The source describes funded activities and does not confirm completion.
funding: Federal award: $150,004 over two years; not total project cost.

record.name: Forest Management Licence #1 development agreement
record.description: March 2026 funding supports FML #1 Consortium Inc. and the four explicitly named Nations in reactivating a Forest Development Agreement. The $597,970 contribution is a consortium award, not a per-Nation allocation or verified project valuation.
record.relationshipType: Named First Nation participant in the FML #1 consortium
funding: Shared federal award: $597,970; not allocated per Nation.

record.name: Twenty-Year Forest Management Plan
record.description: The March 2026 backgrounder reports completion of a feasibility study, business plan and twenty-year forest management plan for the Nation’s logging operation, incorporating community knowledge to protect culturally significant areas.
record.relationshipType: Named community recipient or participant; no ownership percentage inferred
funding: Federal award: $50,500; not total project cost.

record.name: Naatsii timber-harvesting feasibility and business plan
record.description: The March 2026 backgrounder reports that funding was used for a feasibility study and business plan assessing resources and training for timber harvesting on Beaver First Nation’s traditional territory. This does not establish an operating harvest project.
record.relationshipType: Named community recipient or participant; no ownership percentage inferred
funding: Federal award: $47,200; not a verified total cost or operating revenue.

record.name: Temporary K–12 school replacement
record.description: The temporary school opened October 22, 2026, after the previous school was destroyed by fire. Seventeen ready-to-move units provide classrooms, Head Start and daycare space. Federal funding is reported as $15 million, not a verified total project cost.

record.name: Permanent school replacement planning
record.description: The October 22, 2026 release reports planning and schematic design underway for a permanent school replacement. No construction start, completion date or total budget is inferred.

record.name: Cree Nations Miyoyawin Centre replacement
record.description: The October 2026 release reports completion of the residential treatment facility at Ahtahkakoop, governed by a board representing the four named Nations. Dedicated detoxification space is described as a future operational component; it is not presented as already open.
funding: ISC contribution: $29.3 million; Ahtahkakoop contribution: $1.8 million toward detoxification space. Shared funding is not allocated per Nation.
